feature: Risk-Based Decisions: linked-check picker (accepted-risk alert suppression, Git #1294)
notes: SCOPE: #1279 added msp_risk_decisions.check_key (nullable, suppresses accepted-risk alert
re-firing) but left it settable only via a raw POST /api/msp/rbd body field -- no UI existed to set
it. This closes that seam inside the RiskBasedDecisionConsole (artifacts/msp-portal), NOT AdminV2:
the console's audience is MSPAdmin/MSPOperator staff (they author every RBD today, per #1279's own
investigation), and AdminV2 (artifacts/admin-panel/src/adminv2) is gated to role==='admin' (PlatformAdmin)
only -- an MSP tech can never reach it. Putting the picker there would not have activated suppression
for the people who actually create these decisions.
WHAT WAS BUILT: GET /api/msp/rbd/available-checks (new, MSPOperator-readable, read-only monitor_checks
catalog: key/label/description) backs a <select> added to RiskBasedDecisionConsole's create wizard Step 1
('Linked Automated Check (optional)', data-testid=rbd-linked-check-picker). Selecting a check sets
checkKey on the POST /api/msp/rbd payload that #1279 already accepts.
auth: the headless harness cannot mint an MSPAdmin/MSPOperator session JWT (same documented boundary as
test-manifests/admin/testbed-gate-negative.json) -- apiTests below use the ingest token where the route
accepts it and otherwise just prove the auth wall is intact (401 for a non-MSP credential), same honesty
convention as that file. The picker's real DOM/data-flow correctness is asserted via uiSteps against a
genuine MSPAdmin/MSPOperator UI session -- SHANE TO-DO: confirm the login block below authenticates as an
actual MSP-staff account with real monitor_checks rows to choose from (a tenant with zero checks configured
would make step UI3 vacuously pass on an empty list).

apiTests.name: auth wall intact -- available-checks catalog route rejects a non-MSP credential (ingest token has no mspRole, requireRole(MSPOperator) -> 401)
